The '''Namore system''' lay in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Namore]].<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Namore [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced via the appearance of the planet Namore in "[[Live And In (Bleeding) Color&hellip;]]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''. The book was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], provided the system's name and placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
